items.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, maintains neutral stance; revises FY27 inflation projection downwards to 5%
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) kept its repo rate steady at 5.25% in its August policy meeting and maintained a neutral stance. It also slightly revised its FY27 inflation projection downwards to 5% from 5.1%.

items.headline: India's retail inflation rises to 4.45% in July 2026, highest since Dec 2024, driven by energy prices
items.summary: India's retail inflation increased to 4.45% in July 2026, up from 4.38% in June, marking its highest level since December 2024. This rise is attributed to elevated energy prices from the Middle East conflict and its impact on the rupee. Food and beverages (5.52%) and transportation (4.43%) were key contributors. Core inflation remains 'well-behaved', but a potential shortfall in September rainfall could push FY27 consumer price inflation to 5.5% or higher.

items.headline: World Bank President Banga sees India growing beyond 7-8%; India meets FY26 fiscal deficit target at 4.4% of GDP
items.summary: World Bank President Ajay Banga stated that India has the potential to grow beyond its current 7-8% trajectory, citing robust performance in services, exports, and sustained investment. The Union Budget 2026-27 outlined a path for sustained growth, focusing on scaling manufacturing, supporting MSMEs, enhancing infrastructure and energy security, and investing in human capital. India successfully met its fiscal deficit target for the year ended March 31, 2026, at 4.4% of GDP, and aims for a debt-to-GDP ratio of 50% by 2030.

items.headline: US-Iran conflict escalation and renewed airstrikes weigh heavily on global investor sentiment
items.summary: The ongoing escalation in the US-Iran conflict, with renewed airstrikes, has significantly impacted global investor sentiment, leading to a broad risk-off mood.

items.headline: Brent crude surges towards $95-$97 on Strait of Hormuz disruption fears, impacting India
items.summary: Brent crude surged towards $95-$97 per barrel due to intensified concerns over potential supply disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil transit route. This is a major concern for oil-import-dependent India.

items.headline: Asian markets tumble, US stocks close lower amid geopolitical tensions, rising oil prices and rate hike fears
items.summary: Asian markets tumbled in early trade, with Japan's Nikkei 225 declining around 2.2-2.9% and South Korea's Kospi falling 3-3.08%. US stocks also closed lower on Tuesday, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average down 0.79%, S&P 500 down 0.71%, and Nasdaq Composite down 1.03%, primarily due to rising bond yields and inflation concerns.

items.headline: Surging oil prices revive fears of September Fed rate hike; 67% probability assigned
items.summary: Surging oil prices have revived fears that the US Federal Reserve might raise rates rather than cut them, with markets assigning a 67% probability of a 25-basis-point Fed rate hike in September.

items.headline: Nifty 50 companies report 18% YoY PAT growth in Q1 FY27 earnings season
items.summary: The Q1 FY27 earnings season showed a positive fundamental backdrop, with Nifty 50 companies reporting an average 18% year-on-year growth in profit after tax.

items.headline: Milky Mist Q1 FY27 PAT surges 889.81% YoY, revenue up 43.6%
items.summary: Milky Mist reported an 889.81% year-on-year surge in profit after tax (PAT) and a 43.6% increase in revenue from operations for Q1 FY27, driven by strong sales across its product portfolio.

items.headline: Leap India Q1 FY27 net profit up 30.23% YoY, sales up 19.10%
items.summary: Leap India saw its net profit increase by 30.23% year-on-year and sales by 19.10% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.

items.headline: Marksans Pharma Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit jumps 173.9% YoY, revenue up 35.6%, achieves all-time high EBITDA
items.summary: Marksans Pharma reported a 173.9% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit and 35.6% growth in total operating revenue for Q1 FY27, achieving an all-time high EBITDA.

items.headline: Indian equity benchmarks closed mildly negative Tuesday, banking, auto, pharma down, IT, FMCG up
items.summary: Indian equity benchmarks ended Tuesday with a mild negative bias, with losses in banking, auto, and pharma stocks outweighing gains in IT, FMCG, and select heavyweights.

items.headline: All sectoral indices open in red, IT, Auto, Metals, Realty, Media, PSU Bank lead declines
items.summary: Today, all sectoral indices opened in the red, with Nifty IT, Nifty Auto, Nifty Metals, Nifty Realty, Nifty Media, and Nifty PSU Bank leading the declines. Broader markets, including the Nifty Smallcap 100 and Nifty Midcap 100, also experienced selling pressure.

items.headline: Oil-sensitive sectors like paints, tyres, aviation, chemicals to face pressure from rising crude; upstream oil producers to benefit
items.summary: Oil-sensitive sectors such as paints, tyres, aviation, and chemicals are expected to remain under pressure due to rising crude prices, impacting margins. Conversely, upstream oil producers like ONGC and Oil India could benefit from higher crude realisations. Downstream oil marketing companies (IOC, BPCL, HPCL) may face margin pressure.

items.headline: Tata Motors secures all regulatory approvals for €3.8bn Iveco Group acquisition
items.summary: Tata Motors has secured all necessary regulatory approvals for its proposed €3.8 billion acquisition of Italian commercial vehicle maker Iveco Group, with the tender offer document awaiting review by Italy's securities regulator.
